recorded_snapshot_probes.basis: Recorded request evidence held constant for300ms to probe eligibility only. No inferred history, participant trajectory, or measured timing. Repeated snapshots are probes, not unique delay episodes.

measurement_basis: Isolated production C# state-machine and policy replay, 50 ms simulated ticks and synthetic 400 ms audio. These are not Unity playback, headset, network, acoustic latency, or participant improvement measurements.

network_comparison.basis: Measured Mac-to-Vercel HTTP requests using synthetic states. Not headset requests or acoustic latency.

requests.choice: Turn left toward the back now.
Turn right toward the back now.
Let's turn left toward the back.
Let's turn right toward the back.

set_comparison.conclusion: Each selected half-open geometry cell has exactly five unique eligible phrases. Small and full are identical; medium cannot be tested from this catalog without adding new valid authored options. API support for larger sets remains untested.

unknowns: No participant behavior, perceptual quality, target recognition, or network performance on headset inferred.
Host pilot waits up to1.5s for diagnostics; requests exceeding450ms would miss the current Unity catalog deadline.
One question per request tests wording only; combined runtime transmit/interruption decisions are not benchmarked here.
Full HintGenerator/VoiceSynthesizer lifecycle and interruption behavior are not executed by this isolated harness.
Visible-highlight reference filtering and the phrase-aware acknowledgment entry gates are covered by separate runtime regression suites, not by these scripted input trajectories.
Adapter only discards pending callbacks at their synthetic ready time; production cancels on revision changes earlier. Synthetic late-response delays are not estimates of production delays.
Simulated starts occur in an adapter, not AudioSource.Play. Recorded software playback must be assessed separately.
Overlap winner and validity are scripted upstream observations, not a test of ray geometry or hardware acquisition.
Jev delay/wait/error outcomes in trajectories are injected. Actual provider requests are a separate report.
Unspoken qualifications interrupted by departure are not classified as missed confirmations without a complete scheduling model.
Perceived naturalness and behavioral benefit require a wearer pilot; advisory Astra ratings do not establish them.
